descriptionHtml:
Approach · TC-06 Admission Status Toggle · S16 Generate with status words in the dictation: badge unchanged, note written in the template chosen (hand pick in Hospital, pre-selection in Nursing Home), badge still changeable after Generate

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U11 The app never sets the status from dictation, in either direction (up to New Admission / Consult, or down to Follow-up): add-form dictation, pre-round Save Note, encounter Save & Extract, Quick Dicta … (UAT TC-06; TFA-92584 AC 5)
  • U9 The physician still sees the template picker at Generate and can change the pre-selected template by hand; changing the template does not change the badge, and Generate writes the note in the templat … (UAT TC-06; TFA-92584 AC 6)
  • U8 The badge pre-selects the template at Generate: Hospital New Admission -> H&P, Follow-up -> SOAP progress, Consult -> Consult note; … (UAT TC-06; TFA-92584 AC 6; TFA-92584 AC 7)
  • U4 The physician can change the badge by hand at any time (before or after Generate, and on a patient whose status already rolled) through all three states, and each change persists (list, chart, reload … (UAT TC-06; TFA-92584 AC 1)
  • U12 All of the above works in both Hospital and Nursing Home (step 7, ground rule 3.3) (UAT TC-06; UAT 3.3; TFA-92584 AC 7)

Test design technique: Error guessing (error-guessing) — Go straight for the places most likely to break (failures, double clicks, two tabs, a wrong clock, injected instructions).

Given Session fixture; Hospital patient untouched (Follow-up); Nursing Home resident set by hand to New Admission during the run

When Hospital: type upgrade words into encounter notes, change Note Format by hand to Consult note, press Generate Note & Finish. Nursing Home: set New Admission, check SNF admission is pre-selected, type downgrade words, press Generate Note & Finish without touching Note Format; …

Then Hospital badge stays Follow-up after Generate and the stored note template is consult (the hand pick); the resident's badge stays New Admission after Generate and the stored template is snf-admission (the pre-selection); after the change to Follow-up on a generated note the status is saved and Note Format pre-selects SNF follow-up for the regenerate

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): UAT TC-06 'never sets status from dictation' + 'the physician can change the template at Generate' + 'the badge can be changed by hand at any time'. Snapshots: the badge [selected] after Generate plus 'button "Copy to EMR"' (PostRoundTab.tsx:215; …

Where it ran: dev unit U43; test method AGENT · Browser agent; lane planned in the matrix: browser agent (blocked)
